articles.headline: Lionel Messi: Argentina's 2026 World Cup final heartbreak "part of my football journey"
articles.description: Lionel Messi has accepted that Argentina's 2026 World Cup extra-time defeat to Spain was a part of his football journey.

articles.headline: Asian football chief backs Gianni Infantino for another term as FIFA president
articles.description: The Asian Football Confederation endorsed Gianni Infantino on Friday for a fourth term as FIFA president.

articles.headline: AFC president unclear on backing for Infantino's FIFA reelection
articles.description: The president of the AFC gave no hint Thursday about the body's support or opposition to the reelection of Gianni Infantino as FIFA president.

articles.headline: Premier League best place to develop Japanese talent - Japan FA chief
articles.description: The best place to develop Japanese talent is in the English Premier League, the president of the Japan Football Association has said.

articles.headline: Gianni Infantino courts Asian Football Confederation in reelection campaign bid
articles.description: Gianni Infantino's campaign for reelection as FIFA president is set to move this week to Japan and a meeting scheduled for Wednesday with the Asian Football Confederation.
